svg.title: Multica setup - git flow
svg.desc: A workflow diagram generated by Archify.

g.aria-label: Focus Owner Review, approve or reject, Owner (you) › Integrate
g.title: Owner Review · approve or reject · Owner (you) › Integrate · only human merge

g.aria-label: Focus Sync blocked, apply manual steps, Owner (you) › Sync to live
g.title: Sync blocked · apply manual steps · Owner (you) › Sync to live · tag not moved

g.aria-label: Focus Fix Commit, 1 per Fix Issue, dev branch (via agent/setup-steward worktree) › Commit
g.title: Fix Commit · 1 per Fix Issue · dev branch (via agent/setup-steward worktree) › Commit · drunk bundle only

g.aria-label: Focus dev tip, push HEAD:refs/heads/dev, dev branch (via agent/setup-steward worktree) › Integrate
g.title: dev tip · push HEAD:refs/heads/dev · dev branch (via agent/setup-steward worktree) › Integrate · verify git ls-remote

g.aria-label: Focus PR dev → main, one open PR, reused, dev branch (via agent/setup-steward worktree) › Integrate
g.title: PR dev → main · one open PR, reused · dev branch (via agent/setup-steward worktree) › Integrate

g.aria-label: Focus Merge to main, GH Action on push, main branch › Release
g.title: Merge to main · GH Action on push · main branch › Release

g.aria-label: Focus drunk-live-sync.py, diff tag..origin/main, tag live/drunk › Sync to live
g.title: drunk-live-sync.py · diff tag..origin/main · tag live/drunk › Sync to live · lock + read-back

g.aria-label: Focus live/drunk = main, tag -f, push tag, tag live/drunk › Sync to live
g.title: live/drunk = main · tag -f, push tag · tag live/drunk › Sync to live
